name: @zunialab/core
description: Zunia wallet kernel: keys, signing and encryption. The implementation is Rust (see crates/); this package exists to publish the WASM artifact under the npm name consumers already depend on.

scripts.vectors:cosmos: cd tests/vectors/generate && pnpm install && node generate.mjs
scripts.vectors:addresses: cd tests/vectors/generate && pnpm install && node address-vectors.mjs
scripts.vectors:evm: cd tests/vectors/generate && pnpm install && node evm-vectors.mjs
scripts.vectors:svm: cd tests/vectors/generate && pnpm install && node svm-vectors.mjs
scripts.vectors: pnpm vectors:bip && pnpm vectors:cosmos && pnpm vectors:addresses && pnpm vectors:evm && pnpm vectors:svm
